back: The percentage of total market sales achieved by one business or brand.
Market share (%) = sales of the business ÷ total market sales × 100.
Income, tastes and fashion, technology, population, prices of other goods, social and environmental concerns.

front: Why do markets become more competitive?
back: New entrants, imports and globalisation, e-commerce, lower start-up barriers, better-informed customers.

front: How can businesses respond to changing markets?
back: Research, new products, better quality and service, lower costs, new promotion, new channels, new markets.

front: Can sales rise while market share falls?
back: Yes, if the total market grows faster than the business's sales.
Shows performance against rivals; leaders gain brand recognition, shelf space and economies of scale.
Total sales of all businesses in a market over a period, by value or volume.
